adoption: User decision (2026-10-11): default true with a ready hardware provider; shadow maps otherwise. Explicit false requests maps. P8 retains performance qualification and preset tuning.
gpu_frame_scope: elapsed earliest TOP to latest BOTTOM across native graphics/compute-capable command buffers begun during the application render workload, including graph preparation GPU work and the graphics swapchain copy; excludes dedicated transfer-only buffers, asset startup outside the frame, and screenshot readback; does not directly measure host acquire/present calls or compositor/display latency; dependency waits and submission gaps may be included; requires a common device timestamp domain; this is not GPU-active time or occupancy

benchmark_settings.vsync_note: VSync chooses the existing platform present-mode policy; compositor behavior is not measured

editor_tests.scope: Hardware-ready selection; RT opt-out; voxel/legacy providers; shadow diagnostics; scene replacement; settings and light edits. An impossible map-array size forces map preflight rejection without exhausting physical VRAM.

review_fix_verification.notes: Correctness captures were made before the final editor-only readiness refinement; their executed demo hash is retained in correctness. Windowed captures permit only the existing PRESENT-AFTER-WRITE diagnostic. Original Release benchmark data is unchanged.
